outputContract: ADC blocks must be strict RFC 8259 JSON
Do not output comments, trailing commas, undefined, NaN, Infinity, or functions
All keys must use double quotes; all string values must use double quotes
Never output callback expressions such as (d) => ... or function (...)
Do not set label.position; renderer applies safe defaults by chart type
Supported chart types: line, column, bar, area, pie, rose, scatter, radar, heatmap, funnel, histogram, dualAxes
Always include at least 4-6 realistic data points for visual clarity
Use descriptive field names (e.g., 'month', 'revenue') rather than generic ('x', 'y')
CRITICAL: Data MUST be in LONG (tidy) format — one observation per row. NEVER use wide format where series are column names.
WRONG wide format: {"category":"A", "美国":100, "中国":50} with yField:["美国","中国"]
CORRECT long format: [{"category":"A","value":100,"series":"美国"},{"category":"A","value":50,"series":"中国"}] with yField:"value", colorField:"series"
For multi-series charts (line/column/bar/area/radar/scatter), use colorField to distinguish series — NOT yField as an array
yField must always be a single string field name, never an array (arrays only work in dualAxes)
seriesField is a legacy v1 field — use colorField instead in ADC 2.x
For grouped column/bar charts, add group:true alongside colorField
Do not set color/backgroundColor/textStyle.color -- the renderer applies theme-aware styles automatically for both light and dark modes
CRITICAL: ALL numeric values must be actual JSON numbers, NOT strings. WRONG: "value": "~1.1%". CORRECT: "value": 1.1
CRITICAL: yField must be a JSON string. WRONG: "yField": {"field": "value"}. CORRECT: "yField": "value"
Do not use v1 legacy properties: columnStyle (use style), barStyle (use style), seriesField (use colorField), geometryOptions (removed in v2)

commonErrors: Using callback functions in field mappings
Missing required xField or yField
Data not in array format
chartTypes.tips: Use colorField for multi-series. Add point config for data point markers. Use style.lineWidth for thickness.

commonErrors: Confusing column (vertical) with bar (horizontal)
Missing required fields
Using wide format with yField as array — WRONG. Use long format with yField as string + colorField + group:true
chartTypes.tips: Use group:true or stack:true for multi-series. yField must be a single string. Use colorField to split series. Add style.radiusTopLeft/radiusTopRight for rounded tops.

commonErrors: Swapping xField and yField (bar is horizontal: xField is the value, yField is the category)
Using callbacks for field values
chartTypes.tips: Bar is horizontal: xField = numeric values, yField = categories. Add labels for data values.

commonErrors: Same as line chart errors
Not stacking multiple series properly
chartTypes.tips: Use stack:true for stacked areas. Use style.fillOpacity (0.3-0.6) for semi-transparent fills.

commonErrors: Using xField/yField instead of angleField/colorField
Not providing colorField for legend
chartTypes.tips: Use innerRadius (0.4-0.6) for donut style. Include 4-8 slices for readability.

commonErrors: Using angleField/colorField like pie — rose uses xField/yField
Not providing colorField for legend coloring
chartTypes.tips: Rose charts (nightingale diagrams) show categorical data with varying petal sizes. Good for comparing magnitudes across categories. Use colorField for distinct petal colors.

commonErrors: Missing colorField for category distinction
Data points not in array
chartTypes.tips: Use colorField to categorize points. Use sizeField for bubble effect. Include 10+ data points for clarity.

commonErrors: Wrong field names for radar dimensions
Not normalizing values to similar scale

Using wide format with series as column names — WRONG: {"axis":"Speed","ProductA":90,"ProductB":70} with yField:"value". CORRECT: each row must have ONE value + ONE series identifier like {"dimension":"Speed","score":90,"product":"Product A"}
Using seriesField (legacy v1) instead of colorField (v2)
chartTypes.tips: Include 5-8 dimensions. Use colorField for multi-product comparison. Data must be long format: each row = {dimension, score, product}. Add area.style.fillOpacity for filled radar. NEVER put multiple series as separate columns in one row.

commonErrors: Missing colorField for intensity
Not providing proper grid data structure
chartTypes.tips: Provide complete grid data (every x-y combination). Use labels to show values in cells.

commonErrors: Data not sorted by funnel order (largest to smallest)
Missing value field for stage size
chartTypes.tips: Sort data from largest to smallest stage. Include 4-6 stages. Add labels for counts.

commonErrors: Using xField instead of binField
Not providing raw data for binning
chartTypes.tips: Provide 15+ raw data points for meaningful distribution. Use binField for the numeric field to bin.

commonErrors: Using long format with single yField + colorField — WRONG for dualAxes. DualAxes needs WIDE format with yField as array of TWO field names
WRONG: data=[{x:'A',metric:'Revenue',value:100},{x:'A',metric:'Growth',value:0.1}], yField:'value', colorField:'metric' — this is a grouped column pattern, NOT dualAxes
CORRECT: data=[{x:'A',revenue:100,growthRate:0.1}], yField:['revenue','growthRate'] — each row has BOTH metrics as separate fields
Using geometryOptions (v1 legacy, removed in v2)
Mixing incompatible chart types
chartTypes.tips: DualAxes is the ONLY chart type where yField is an array. Use exactly TWO field names in yField array. Data must be WIDE format: each row contains both metrics as separate fields. Do NOT use colorField or group with dualAxes. Provide a flat dataset with both metrics per row.
